Whether you’re a BHANGRA fan, a BOLLYWOOD lover or into R&B, HIP HOP & COMMERCIAL anthems, this is the night for YOU! We are proud to continue the great tradition of celebrating South Asian culture for students attending universities all over the U.K!

Sold out yearly in advance, we head to the World Famous MINISTRY OF SOUND to end 2026 in the biggest way possible! Expect 2000+ ravers, superstar headliners & madness over FOUR ROOMS of music!

THE FINAL DESIBEATZ AT MINISTRY OF SOUND FOR 2026 — GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!!

PLAYING LIVE ON THE NIGHT!
★ DJ SENATOR
★ DJ KIZZI

BABY BOX : SOUTH INDIAN BANGERS!

Ministry of Sound operates a new digital ID scanning system that requires ID verification. All attendees must bring valid physical photo ID as a condition of entry for our premises licence. Student ID for this event is also required.

We accept government issued ID such as a photo card driving licence, passport or PASS identification card bearing the PASS hologram. Strictly no ID, no entry.
